Bacterial spot.treatment: Use copper-based bactericides like Copper Oxychloride 0.25%. Remove infected leaves immediately.
Bacterial spot.prevention: Avoid overhead watering. Use disease-free seeds. 3-year crop rotation.

Early blight.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 0.2% or Chlorothalonil 0.2% every 10 days. Remove lower infected leaves.
Early blight.prevention: Mulching to prevent soil splash. Ensure good air circulation between plants.

Late blight.treatment: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 0.25% immediately. Destroy severely infected plants.
Late blight.prevention: Avoid wet conditions. Spray preventive fungicide before monsoon season.

Leaf Mold.treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil 0.2% or Copper fungicide. Reduce humidity in greenhouse.
Leaf Mold.prevention: Improve ventilation. Avoid working in crop when leaves are wet.

Septoria leaf spot.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 0.2% or Azoxystrobin 0.1% every 7-10 days.
Septoria leaf spot.prevention: Remove plant debris. Drip irrigation instead of sprinklers.

Spider mites.treatment: Spray Neem oil 5ml/L or Abamectin 0.5ml/L. Wash leaves with water jet.

Target Spot.treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil 0.2% or Tebuconazole 0.1%. Remove infected plant parts.
Target Spot.prevention: Avoid dense planting. Control weeds around field.

Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.treatment: No cure. Uproot and destroy infected plants immediately.
Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.prevention: Control whiteflies using Yellow sticky traps + Imidacloprid 0.3ml/L spray.

Mosaic virus.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Control aphids with insecticidal soap.
Mosaic virus.prevention: Use virus-free seeds. Disinfect tools. Control aphid vectors.

Healthy.treatment: Plant is healthy. Continue current care routine.
Healthy.prevention: Regular scouting. Balanced fertilization. Maintain field hygiene.
